meaning: 他可以过上快乐健康的生活
usageNote: It was possible for sb. to do 是正式说法，就是'某人当时有可能做某事'，比 He could 听起来更书面一点！

examples.en: It was possible for her to finish the project on time with some help.
examples.zh: 在一些帮助下，她有可能按时完成这个项目。

examples.en: It was possible for them to reach an agreement after long discussions.
examples.zh: 经过长时间讨论，他们有可能达成协议。
